tiles.headline: Practice through the festivities!
tiles.body: We close for Christmas after classes on MON 21 Dec, then we're back on SUN 27 Dec for a few cosy classes between Christmas and New Year. Perfect for shaking off the mince pies. Full timetable returns on SAT 2 Jan.

tiles.headline: Next 5 week block starting!
tiles.body: Join us from the 10th Jan- 7th Feb every Sunday with Katie, who specialises in prenatal yoga. Ease the aches, build strength for birth, and meet other mums-to-be. Suitable from 14 weeks to full term.

tiles.headline: Yin & Pj's the perfect combo
tiles.body: The to-do list is long, the to-buy list is longer and stillness feels like the one thing you haven't had time for. This "Warm Candlelit Yin" class is your permission to stop before the festive rush properly kicks in.

tiles.headline: Try the whole studio for £35
tiles.body: Twenty-one days of classes for £35. Every style, every teacher, no commitment. The easiest way to start.

tiles.headline: Hot class? Bring a towel
tiles.sub: Studio news · What to bring to the heat
tiles.body: Every hot class needs a towel long enough to cover your mat. Rent one at the studio for £4 or buy your own for £28. Mat rental is £2 a class.
